narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Five millimetres is written as five centimetres in the table, because the number is five.
<bookmark mark='ruler'/>Look at the ruler. Five millimetres is only half of the first centimetre.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Five centimetres is ten times as far, so always write the unit beside the number.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Write one case as one row, with the distances first and the measured length last.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Place ex three centimetres from eigh and why four centimetres from bee. Measure the thread and write its row.
